description: Hey everyone! I'm a Computer Science student at SNHU, focusing on Software Engineering. I've always loved technology, whether it's coding, fixing electronics, or figuring out how things work. I have experience with Python, SQL, and building games and applications. My dream is to become a software engineer at NASA! This is my first Space Apps Challenge, so I'm excited and a little nervous! I'm planning to work solo, but I'd love to connect with others and learn along the way!
